description: When this server cannot get the data (no key stored here, a host that refuses scripts, a network block): write one bundle for one or more sources with download scripts (.sh and .ps1, every request built in, any key asked with hidden input on the user's own computer) and INSTRUCTIONS.md. Then ingest the files the user downloads.

reason.description: Why the user downloads by hand (shown in INSTRUCTIONS.md)

spec.description: Most sources: {"description": "...", "requests": [{"name", "endpoint", "params", "max_rows"}]}. Deep sources (bea, bls, fred, ipums, opm, treasury) have their own format: see source_brief and request_schema.

name: manual_bundle
title: Manual download bundle
